name: minute-2026-recency-v1
purpose: Separate study of daily trend + intraday session features on 2026 data. Distinct from M3.2; never scored against the M3.2 locked holdout.
conflict_with_m32: All 2026 sessions fall inside or after the M3.2 locked-holdout range (earliest 2025-10-21). Executing this study consumes those dates for this study only; M3.2 models must still be scored on them exactly once, before any 2026 result is inspected. Requires explicit approval.

source.minute_root: CANDIDATE: a new versioned root created by the authorized copy-only reconciliation (not data/raw/shoonya/NSE/minute/)
source.manifest: REQUIRED: hash manifest of every payload before any decode

partitions.final_test_rule: Opened once, after the configuration is frozen by validation results; hashed manifest written before opening.

features.daily: V1 indicators (EMA, RSI, MACD, ATR, volatility, volume)
features.intraday: session summaries via stock_gplm.mvp.research.IntradayFeatureSource, available after 15:30 IST

trial_budget: REQUIRED before execution (proposal: 20 per horizon, shared ledger)
